    backend.BCnt) : (backend.commitSt st C' tx' cnt').R = st.R.reset

theorem backend.bgOk_setHw {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {free : Bool} {n w u : Nat} (x
    : Bool) (h : backend.bgOk P st free n w u) : backend.bgOk P (st.setHw x) free n w u

theorem backend.length_bkOf_wbMerge (W R : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (i : w64) : (backend.bkOf
    (backend.wbMerge W R) i).length ≤ (backend.bkOf R i).length + (backend.bkOf W i).length

theorem backend.commitSt_S (st : backend.BSess) (C' : backend.Data) (tx' : Loc) (cnt' :
    backend.BCnt) : (backend.commitSt st C' tx' cnt').S = st.S

theorem backend.bkOf_wbMerge (W R : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (i : w64) : backend.bkOf
    (backend.wbMerge W R) i = match W !! i with | some es => backend.canon (backend.bkOf R i ++ es)
    | none => backend.bkOf R i

theorem backend.agreeOff_trans {HB : GoString → Bool} {f g h : backend.VFun} (h1 : backend.agreeOff
    HB f g) (h2 : backend.agreeOff HB g h) : backend.agreeOff HB f h

theorem backend.bkOf_bksResetC (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (i : w64) : backend.bkOf
    (backend.bksReset B) i = []

theorem backend.viewSame_of_freeOk {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (h : backend.freeOk P
    st) : backend.viewSame P st

theorem backend.commit_bgOk {P : backend.BParams} {st st' : backend.BSess} {C' : backend.Data} {tx'
    : Loc} {n w u k' : Nat} (hW : ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false →
    backend.bkOf st.W.bks i = []) (hp0 : st.cnt.p0 = sint.nat st.pend) (hs : backend.hookStep P st
    st') (hst : backend.sessWf P st) (hb' : backend.bgOk P st' false n w u) (n' w' u' : Nat) (hbud :
    uint.Z st.R.ver + ↑n' + ↑k' < 2 ^ 40) (huw : u' ≤ w') (hc : st.cnt.c + 1 ≤ k' + 1 + if u' = w'
    then 1 else 0) (hwv : ↑w' ≤ uint.Z st.R.ver) : backend.bgOk P (backend.commitSt st' C' tx' { k
    := k', c := st.cnt.c + 1, p0 := 0, e := 0, hw := false }) true n' w' u'

theorem backend.vData_free (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (hst : backend.sessWf P st)
    (hn : st.ndel = W64 0) (hW : ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false →
    backend.bkOf st.W.bks i = []) : backend.vData P (st.C, st.R) = backend.sData P st.S

theorem backend.commit_final {P : backend.BParams} {st st' : backend.BSess} {C' : backend.Data} {tx'
    : Loc} {cnt' : backend.BCnt} (hP : P.Wf) (hst : backend.sessWf P st) (hcnt : cnt'.hw = false)
    (hW : ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf st.W.bks i
    = []) (hs : backend.hookStep P st st') (hst' : backend.sessWf P st') (hC' : C' = st'.S ∨
    st'.pend = W64 0 ∧ C' = st'.C) : backend.sessWf P (backend.commitSt st' C' tx' cnt') ∧
    backend.freeOk P (backend.commitSt st' C' tx' cnt') ∧ backend.vData P (C', st'.R.reset) =
    backend.sData P st.S

theorem backend.agreeOff_ovB_nonHB (P : backend.BParams) (W : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (f :
    backend.VFun) (h : ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false →
    backend.bkOf W i = []) : backend.agreeOff P.HB (backend.ovB P.BT W f) f

    backend.idsOk P B) : backend.idsOk P (backend.bksReset B)

theorem backend.vOf_emptyR (P : backend.BParams) (C : backend.Data) : backend.vOf P (C, { bks := ∅,
    ver := W64 0 }) = backend.dget C

theorem backend.commitSt_C (st : backend.BSess) (C' : backend.Data) (tx' : Loc) (cnt' :
    backend.BCnt) : (backend.commitSt st C' tx' cnt').C = C'

def backend.BSess.setHw (st : backend.BSess) (x : Bool) : backend.BSess :=
  { C := st.C, S := st.S, R := st.R, W := st.W, pend := st.pend, ndel := st.ndel, tx := st.tx,
    cnt :=
      have __src := st.cnt;
      { k := __src.k, c := __src.c, p0 := __src.p0, e := __src.e, hw := x } }

theorem backend.agree_of_vData_eq (P : backend.BParams) (rv rv' : backend.RView) (h : backend.vData
    P rv = backend.vData P rv') : backend.agreeOff P.HB (backend.vOf P rv) (backend.vOf P rv')

def backend.commitSt (st : backend.BSess) (C' : backend.Data) (tx' : Loc) (cnt' : backend.BCnt) :
    backend.BSess :=
  { C := C', S := st.S, R := st.R.reset, W := st.W, pend := W64 0, ndel := W64 0, tx := tx', cnt := cnt' }

theorem backend.hookWin_of {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {n w u : Nat} (hb :
    backend.bgOk P st false n w u) (hp0 : st.cnt.p0 = sint.nat st.pend) (i : w64) : backend.bkOf
    st.W.bks i = [] ∨ backend.bkOf st.R.bks i = []

    backend.VFun) (h : ∀ (i : w64), backend.bkOf B i = []) : backend.ovB BT B f = f

    backend.VFun) : backend.ovB BT (backend.wbMerge W R) f = backend.ovB BT W (backend.ovB BT R f)

    backend.agreeOff P.HB (backend.vOf P rv) (backend.vOf P rv')) : backend.vData P rv =
    backend.vData P rv'

theorem backend.vOf_resetC (P : backend.BParams) (C : backend.Data) (R : backend.RBuf) : backend.vOf
    P (C, R.reset) = backend.dget C

theorem backend.bkOf_wbMerge' (W R : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (i : w64) : backend.lastVal
    (backend.bkOf (backend.wbMerge W R) i) = fun k => (backend.lastVal (backend.bkOf W i) k).or
    (backend.lastVal (backend.bkOf R i) k)

theorem backend.room_of_freeOk {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (hP : P.Wf) (h :
    backend.freeOk P st) : sint.Z st.pend + ↑P.hookMax < 2 ^ 58
